posts.title: AWS CVEs 2024-2026: Is AI Finding the Bugs, or Writing Them?
posts.description: 231 AWS security bulletins, 298 CVEs, 111 cloned repos and a lot of git blame. Is AI behind the AWS CVE explosion, as the finder or as the author?

posts.title: AWS Built an Emulator for Everything. It Thinks Nobody Is Famous.
posts.description: AWS built a local emulator for its entire cloud with autonomous AI agents, then published every gap they found along the way. A tour of the funniest issues, the AWS quirks they expose, and why that honesty is the real story.

posts.title: The Developer's Hierarchy of Needs Is Being Eaten From the Bottom
posts.description: What used to be the summit of software work, taste and judgment, is becoming the new baseline as AI eats the bottom tiers. A look at the inversion and the identity cost that comes with it.
